summary: Ran all six gate checks on the target: secrets (gitleaks), SCA (osv-scanner), SAST (semgrep), IaC (trivy config), SBOM and licence (syft); the container check was skipped, no Dockerfile found. Gate FAILED under fixtures/gate-policy.yaml: 8 blocking items across 5 checks (2 leaked credentials, minimist GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h critical, subprocess shell=True, 3 high k8s misconfigs, GPL-3.0-only component).

findings.title: secrets check blocked the gate: 2 leaked credentials in scripts/release.sh
findings.description: gitleaks reports github-pat and curl-auth-header on scripts/release.sh:2; policy secrets_fail_on=any makes every leak blocking.
findings.remediation: Remove the token from the script, rotate it, and read it from the environment or a secret store.

findings.title: sca check blocked the gate: minimist 1.2.5 has a critical advisory
findings.description: GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h (prototype pollution, max_severity 9.8) affects minimist 1.2.5; sca_fail_severities=[critical, high] and a fix (1.2.6) exists.

findings.title: sast check blocked the gate: subprocess with shell=True on request input
findings.description: Rule fixtures.python.subprocess-shell-true (ERROR) hits app/tools.py:11 where a request parameter is concatenated into a shell command; sast_fail_severities=[critical, high].
findings.remediation: Pass the value as an argument list with shell=False and validate the host input.

findings.title: iac check blocked the gate: 3 high misconfigurations in k8s/deployment.yaml
findings.description: 17 misconfigurations total; KSV-0017 (privileged), KSV-0014 (root filesystem not read-only) and KSV-0118 (default security context) are high and iac_fail_severities=[critical, high].
findings.remediation: Set privileged: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and an explicit securityContext with capabilities dropped.

findings.title: licence check blocked the gate: lab-pdf-render is GPL-3.0-only
findings.description: The syft SBOM declares lab-pdf-render 0.9.0 as GPL-3.0-only, which is on the policy licence_deny list.
findings.remediation: Replace the component or get a written licence exception recorded in the policy.
